purpose: Teach: 柏崎/佐野/矢野/松永/白石/吉岡/小松/亀井

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 柏崎発電所との契約を更新しましょう
lines.en: Let's renew the contract with the Kashiwazaki Power Station.
lines.style: Brisk, businesslike opening. Crisp attack on the first word. Even tempo, no softening. Speaking as someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。佐野部長の歓迎会を準備します
lines.en: Got it. I'll get the welcome reception for Director Sano organized.
lines.style: Warm agreement, no hesitation. Quick affirmative. Efficient tempo, light and willing. The ease of someone who knows what's expected.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 矢野課長の引き継ぎ書を確認しましょう
lines.en: And let's review Manager Yano's transition handover notes.
lines.style: Clear, methodical instruction. Slight pause before the task. Measured pace. Professional but not cold—the voice of someone delegating with trust.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。松永技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有します
lines.en: Understood. I'll share the project progress report from Matsunaga, our tech lead.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Reliable tempo. No embellishment—just the next task, delivered with quiet competence. Light on the final clause.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 白石広報の月次企画書を確認しましょう
lines.en: Next, let's check over Shiraishi's monthly PR planning proposal.
lines.style: Continuity in the list. Steady rhythm. Brief pause between items. Clear directional tone—moving the meeting forward without rushing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。吉岡経理の決算予定を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the fiscal closing schedule from Yoshioka in accounting is set.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, no lag. Smooth transition to the next action. Reliable, unhurried pace. The kind of "yes" that means "already thinking ahead."

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 小松人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's request the new employee training plan from the HR department—Komatsu.
lines.style: Task stated plainly. Slight emphasis on the delegation aspect. Even pacing. The voice of someone moving through a necessary checklist with purpose.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。亀井法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: Done. I'll ask the legal team—Kamei—to review the new contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly lighter. Quick and clean closure. Tempo picks up just fractionally on the closing detail. Signals the end of the list.
